editorial:
Imagine a world where high-ranking army generals and self-proclaimed psychics team up to dig for an alien spaceship in the middle of a tiny village. That is exactly the wild ride you get here. Set in the 1990s right after communism fell in Bulgaria, the movie follows a group of powerful men who are desperate to find a magical artifact to make their country a superpower again. The vibe is a perfect mix of a serious military operation and a complete circus, making you wonder if anyone in the room actually knows what they are doing. It feels like a fever dream where the characters are totally convinced they are on the verge of a historic discovery, while you are just laughing at the absurdity of it all.

You will love how the movie plays with your head, blending mystery with some really sharp comedy. The acting is spot on, especially the way the officers try to act tough while following the lead of people who claim to see the future. While the pacing slows down a bit in the middle, the payoff is worth it because the twists are genuinely surprising. If you enjoy stories about government secrets and people acting crazy, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick watch, but if you want the best picture quality, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: The ending reveals that the whole search for the alien artifact was a giant lie based on greed and ego. After all the digging and the psychic claims, no spaceship is ever found. The officers and psychics realize they were just chasing a fantasy to gain power. It wraps up by showing how the chaos of the era allowed these delusions to grow, leaving you with a funny but sad look at how easily people can be fooled.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves weird history and dark comedy.
